newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's share index rises 10.26 points in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's share index rises 10.26 points in week.

text.p: Bahrain's share index ended the week to Thursday 10.26 points higher in active trade focused on banks and investment firms, Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said.
It said the index rose to 1,503.06 points from 1,492.80 points last week.
Six million shares worth 1.9 million dinars ($5 million) were traded in the five-day week, down from 10.4 million shares the previous week.
Shares of 23 companies out of 39 registered in the bourse changed hands in 191 transactions.
The BSE said Investcorp led the market in terms of value with more than 1.3 million shares worth 888,799 dinars dealt. The share closed at $1.84.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank came next with 708,468 shares worth 233,789 dinars traded. It closed at 330 fils.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
